description: Defines classes ConfigSection and ConfigFile for managing configuration data, including loading, property access, and section management within the header_checker::utils namespace.

classes.name: ConfigSection
classes.description: Represents a configuration section with properties and ignored linker set keys.

classes.name: ConfigFile
classes.description: Manages multiple configuration sections, supports loading and property retrieval.

methods.name: HasProperty
methods.description: Checks if a property exists in the section.

methods.name: GetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property in the section.

methods.name: GetIgnoredLinkerSetKeys
methods.description: Returns the list of ignored linker set keys.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to beginning of properties.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to end of properties.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads configuration data from a file path or input stream.

methods.name: HasSection
methods.description: Checks if a section exists for given name and version.

methods.name: HasGlobalSection
methods.description: Checks for existence of a global section.

methods.name: HasProperty
methods.description: Checks if a property exists within a section.

methods.name: GetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value within a section.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to beginning of map.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to end of map.
